authority.source: accepted XM BTCUSD# closed-bar OHLC snapshot

anchor_families.definition: current closed M15 close exceeds the prior 20-bar high or falls below the prior 20-bar low
previous closed M15 bar is a causal 20-bar extreme and the current bar reverses at least 0.30 ATR away from that extreme
prior 16-bar median true range is below 0.75 of the prior 96-bar median and current range is at least 1.80 times the prior 96-bar median with body at least 0.60 of range
first occurrence of each preregistered named phase-transition type using the frozen state-transition definitions
previous close was outside the prior 20-bar range and current close returns inside it
causal EMA20 four-bar slope crosses zero and absolute slope change is at least 0.08 ATR

trajectory_contract.censoring: neither barrier reached within 32 M15 bars

required_outputs: anchor registry with exact timestamp, family, subtype and direction
counts over 24 months, events per month and monthly min/median/max
MFE, MAE, net directional displacement and pullback depth by checkpoint
breakdown by D1 UP, NEUTRAL and DOWN
breakdown by ATR-distance-since-anchor and extension maturity bins
interpretation_rules: This stage is forensic and does not authorize a trading candidate.
All anchor families remain in the report even when unprofitable or sparse.
No threshold, family, direction, horizon or barrier may be changed after outcome inspection.
An anchor family passing forensic gates may only proceed to a separately preregistered conditional model and exact-M1 PnL stage.
Previously strong EARLY_IMPULSE LONG and EXHAUSTION_TO_REVERSAL SHORT patterns receive no preferential inclusion or threshold treatment.
prohibited: 2026 selection, diagnosis or support in this stage
Shadow, Discord, MT5 orders, live-ready or final signal
